# Startup readback: AI-35

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Complete the remaining AI-35 outcome with an evidence-backed Career summary. Repository primary-language metadata is an observed technology only. A demonstrated-skill claim requires an allowlisted, authored, merged pull request with at least one added source-code file that maps to that skill, plus exact pull-request/file links and source/retrieval dates. Repository activity volume alone cannot establish a skill.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

AI-15 and AI-19 are Done. PR #177 merged as `5e898c1d574feee944b95481c3e7ecd6482adde0`; its GITHUB-01/GITHUB-02 security work and owner-denial proof are already complete. The existing producer is the authenticated `/api/career/github-sync` proxy into `github-career-sync`, which persists dated rows in `career_github_evidence`. The Career page reads through the authenticated Supabase server client and existing RLS. Integration path: `apps/web/app/api/career/github-sync` → `supabase/functions/github-career-sync` → `career_github_evidence`; apply GITHUB-01, GITHUB-02, and GITHUB-03. Linear `get_agent_context` was attempted but failed with `Tool get_agent_context not found`; checked-in integration guidance is authoritative for this pass.

## Implementation and boundaries

Use the existing authenticated `/api/career/github-sync` → `github-career-sync` flow and `career_github_evidence` JSONB contract. For each of at most five repositories already selected for detail sync, inspect only its first validated owner-authored merged PR and request at most 30 changed-file records using GitHub's [List pull request files API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pulls/pulls?apiVersion=2022-11-28#list-pull-requests-files). Validate owner, repository, PR number, commit blob URL and path; retain only path, blob URL and added-line count, never patch text or provider prose. Upsert under the existing `(user_id, repository_external_id, evidence_kind, source_url)` conflict key. The authenticated Career reader validates these records and claims a narrow language-development skill only when an added source file supports it. Repository language remains an observation. No migration, AI provider call, outreach path, owner change, or browser-side privileged write is in scope.

Career candidates remain pending until this actual headed runner result is accepted. No DB migration or shared DB reset was needed. PR #182 is open; push and require exact-head CI before the root release owner dispatches the candidate with profile `career` and the staging lease.
